patterns.description: On the free-trial path, review shows a 'Verify your card' panel. The first check fails with a gateway error; the primary button starts the paid plan now with a '10% off' lure, while 'Try again' and 'Verify with UPI instead' (small links) succeed. Continue stays disabled until verified. Paid purchases skip the panel.

patterns.description: Pressing 'Cancel plan' on the account page first opens a 'Before you go' card in place: a full-width primary 'Stay and save 50%' button that silently moves the plan to Annual, billed monthly with a new 12-month commitment (disclosed in tiny text). The way on to the cancel screen is a long, self-deprecating link, 'No thanks, I don't want to save. Continue cancelling'. A second offer card sits on the cancel screen.
